data.title: FitTrack Fitness website

data.title: Todo App
data.body: The Todo App is a contemporary, intuitive task management application designed to assist users in efficiently organizing their daily activities.

data.title: EmONC Assessment Uganda
data.body: Emergency Obstetrics and New-born Care (EmONC) assessment is a data collection exercise carried out every five years organized by the Ministry of Health to collect data about mothers and their new-borns. The assessment sought to learn how all accredited facilities nationwide manage birthing mothers.
data.roles: Data Analyst, Oversaw Data Collection (ODK), Provided Technical Support, Conducted Data Cleaning and Standardization

data.title: Weigh Chair (Prototype)
data.body: The Weight Chair is an innovative prototype designed to assist in monitoring and managing weight-related health metrics of disabled patients. This project integrates advanced sensors and microcontrollers to provide real-time data and analytics, ensuring accurate and efficient weight tracking.
